pairs.question: Quis me vocat?
pairs.derivation: Charon's interrogative 'quis me vocat?' answered by the Umbra's 'non vilis umbra.' Speaker labels CHAR. and UMBRA stripped; the dangling verse number 1275 belongs to Charon's following line and is not included. The full reply is just 'non vilis umbra.'

pairs.question: Quid petis?
pairs.answer: Stygium volo tranare flumen, visere beatos sinus.
pairs.derivation: Charon, having identified the shade ('Claudio agnosco satum, caesum a Domitio'), asks 'quid petis?'; the question span is trimmed to the bare interrogative (the identification is framing, not part of the asking). The Umbra answers with its full two-line reply giving what it seeks; speaker labels stripped, verse number 1280 (mid the next line) excluded.

pairs.question: Quis sceleris index, ede.
pairs.answer: Calvisio scelus prodit socia Syllana, Calvisius statim narrat Atimeto, narrat Atimetus mihi: ego conticere nolui infandum nefas.
pairs.derivation: Nero asks who the informer is ('quis sceleris index, ede'); Paris answers with the full chain of informants. Answer kept contiguous through 'infandum nefas' (Paris's complete reply); speaker labels NERO/PAR. and verse number 1500 (in the middle of the cut-off earlier line) not relevant; no interior ellipsis.

pairs.question: Anicete, an actum?
pairs.derivation: Nero's interrogative 'Anicete, an actum?' (is it done?) answered by Anicetus 'nec nihil, nec quod velim.' Speaker labels stripped. Later terse stichomythic exchanges (de me vel illa? / neutro, etc.) are point/counterpoint fragments and were not extracted.
